## Details

<a id="fill_colour_ram"></a>
### [`fill_colour_ram`](../../../../src/screen/colour_ram.asm#L6) `$6AE3`

*routine*

Sets colour RAM row 0 ($d800-$d827) to 9, then fills $d800+Y to $dbff with A. Input: A = colour, Y = first offset. Output: colour_ram_ptr = $dc00, Y = 0.

- **Called from:** [`load_cave_data`](../cave/setup.md#load_cave_data), [`title_options_loop`](../title/options.md#title_options_loop), [`title_screen_setup`](../title/run_title.md#title_screen_setup)
- **Reads:** [`text_ptr`](../../memory-map.md#text_ptr), [`text_ptr_hi`](../../memory-map.md#text_ptr_hi)
- **Writes:** `$D800`, [`text_ptr`](../../memory-map.md#text_ptr), [`text_ptr_hi`](../../memory-map.md#text_ptr_hi)

| Label | Address | Comment |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="fill_colour_ram_row0"></a>[`fill_colour_ram_row0`](../../../../src/screen/colour_ram.asm#L10) | `$6AE8` | Row 0 gets colour 9 (multicolour, colour 1). |
| <a id="fill_colour_ram_loop"></a>[`fill_colour_ram_loop`](../../../../src/screen/colour_ram.asm#L20) | `$6AF9` | Fills four pages, $d8-$db. |
